svg.text: Web ingress — ALB/WAF versus NLB passthrough
Choose where TLS terminates and which tuple the firewall sees
FORWARD → Read steps 1–5 from left to right
attached to NLB as a generic
source may be the proxy rather
RETURN ← Start at step 6 on the right; follow steps 6–10 back to the source
If an inline tier was inserted,
Draw pre-LB and post-LB inspection as separate stages.
ALB requires two TCP legs; a TLS NLB listener also
terminates TLS. Avoid asserting universal client-IP
preservation for all NLB target combinations.
WAF inspects supported HTTP/S request components
within configured limits. Network Firewall/GWLB provide
visibility depends on the termination or TLS-inspection
Compare access logs, WAF logs, firewall tuples and
target captures. Test origin/backend bypass, health
checks and a benign WAF test rule. One connection
tuple cannot describe the entire ALB proxy chain.
REFERENCES — full clickable source links and validation commands are in the companion Markdown report.
